Lunch sponsored by Eukarya/Re:Earth & Geo Technologies  | Registration Desk

Lunch Boxes

Lunch boxes will be provided for participants attending the workshops and the main conference. Please collect your lunch box at the following locations:

- Workshop days: In front of the registration desk










Registration Desk

Please collect your badge and any pre-ordered merchandise from the registration desk at the conference venue.

Location:
- Workshop Day 1 (8/30): ***RCC Bunka Center Room 609
- Workshop Day 2 (8/31): ***RCC Bunka Center 7th lobby

Opening Hours:
- Workshop days: 9:00–17:00




Registration / Check-in

Please present the QR code included in the confirmation email you received when registering for the Conference at the registration desk.
